text: DE / EN Career Contact Press Your industry Your topic Our services Our references About us search Breadcrumb Home Zero Carbon Magazine Solar systems for the beverage industry: how breweries use the potential of photovoltaics Solar systems for the beverage industry: how breweries use the potential of photovoltaics Add to Bookmarks 12 November 2024 Renewable energy Photovoltaics Decarbonization How can the brewing industry reduce energy consumption and minimize its CO2 emissions? Our future-proof tip for breweries: the use of photovoltaic systems. As a specialized service provider with many years of expertise, SOLARIMO supports breweries and malt houses with tailor-made solar systems for the industry on their way to climate neutrality. Share article Facebook LinkedIn Xing Whatsapp Email Decarbonization is one of the most important tasks of our time. SMEs in particular are facing major challenges in this area. For example, the political and regulatory requirements - keyword: Environmental Social Governance (ESG) criteria and EU taxonomy - are becoming increasingly complex. Nevertheless, many companies want to drive forward their own decarbonization and make a contribution to achieving climate protection targets. However, they often lack the technical and human resources as well as the financial means. To ensure that medium-sized companies in particular can act sustainably and still focus on their core business, the expertise of specialists is available - such as the energy service provider SOLARIMOopen_in_new, a subsidiary of ENGIE Deutschland with a focus on future-oriented solar systems for industry. Solar systems for industry: a guarantee of success In practice, it has been shown time and again that solar power is the quickest, cheapest and easiest first step towards becoming more sustainable. Almost all medium-sized manufacturing companies have large roofs of production halls and warehouses, parking lots and open spaces that offer perfect conditions for the construction of solar systems for industry - but currently remain unused. This is why SOLARIMO has been developing and implementing appropriate photovoltaic solutions for commercial and industrial customers, public clients and housing associations throughout Germany for many years. In fact, the installation of high-performance solar systems in industry is particularly recommended for the manufacturing sector, as these companies have consistently high consumption levels. Large companies and global corporations are therefore leading the way and are already making extensive use of photovoltaics; however, with the support of SOLARIMO, medium-sized companies can also benefit from the advantages. This also applies to breweries, for which the use of photovoltaics opens up real added value. Focus on the core business On-site PPAs (Power Purchase Agreements) with photovoltaics are particularly suitable for breweries: these electricity supply contracts with solar systems on the brewery's own premises work completely without any investment on the part of the company and with very little effort on its part. Depending on requirements and space, ground-mounted, rooftop or carport solutions are available; in general, ground-mounted solar systems are the most common solution in the industry. When implementing photovoltaics in breweries, SOLARIMO promises an all-round carefree package from a single source: the team of experts plans, builds, operates and markets the systems directly on the company premises. For breweries and malt houses, this means that they can concentrate on their day-to-day business and do not have to worry about permits or an initial investment - and still do something good for the environment and benefit from inexpensive, green electricity. This is because the sustainable electricity is generated locally, relieves the strain on the grids and ensures a self-sufficient supply; an important aspect in view of the volatility on the electricity market. Accelerating decarbonization In this way, SOLARIMO supports companies in reliably supplying themselves with green electricity via an on-site PPA, decoupled from the energy markets. And in the long term: the modern electricity supply contracts generally run for a period of 20 years and offer a fixed price for the electricity supply. This ensures good planning reliability - and enormous savings. For a photovoltaic system with an output of one megawatt, the average electricity price is only between ten and 15 cents. In short: solar systems are worthwhile for industry in both economic and ecological terms - and are a reliable option for decarbonization. Using photovoltaics effectively in breweries This reliability plays a particularly important role in the brewing industry, as all areas of the food industry are extremely sensitive. Sustainable production must be combined with the highest quality standards. SOLARIMO scores highly here with innovative photovoltaic solutions for breweries. The specialist can also draw on the extensive industry expertise of ENGIE Deutschland. But how does an onsite PPA with SOLARIMO and ENGIE Deutschland actually work for breweries that want to rely on photovoltaics? In order to assess whether ground-mounted, rooftop or carport solutions are suitable for the respective company, SOLARIMO's experts first examine the areas available for photovoltaics in breweries and assess their potential. Taking into account power load profiles, static conditions, existing electrical connections and building permits, the photovoltaic service provider creates a customized concept for the use of solar systems for the industrial company. The specialists examine the customer's previous electricity expenditure and generally show a more cost-effective alternative. It is also an advantage if SOLARIMO is familiar with the development plans for the brewery campus.
